import csv
with open('/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/data/ate_summary.csv') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        if row.get('group') == 'overall':
            raw = float(row['raw_ate'])
            corrected = float(row['corrected_ate'])
            ratio = corrected / raw if abs(raw) > 1e-6 else float('inf')
            print(f'Raw ATE: {raw:+.4f}')
            print(f'Corrected ATE: {corrected:+.4f}')
            print(f'RATE ratio: {ratio:.4f}')
            break
"
